description: An internal HR memo detailing the onboarding of a new engineering lead. The document contains highly sensitive employee information including direct deposit banking details and a social security number.
keyFindings: Identified full name and personal contact information (email, phone).
Detected highly sensitive Social Security Number (SSN).
Detected direct deposit banking details (Bank Name, Account, Routing Number).
recommendations: Ensure this document is stored in an encrypted HR database with strict access controls.
Do not transmit this document over unencrypted email channels.
Automatically redact SSN and banking details before internal circulation.
